result.summary: Diffed dc93092/cf28a46 against design df5b2a9's section 4.5/4.6 line by line. Parsing now targets the real installed cli_formatter.ex shape confirmed by RELEASE-VALIDATOR's live runs: a 'Result: <passed>[/<total>] passed[ (<breakdown>)]' line (always present, three sub-cases matched: N/M, bare N, degenerate 0-tests) plus a separate 'Failed: <n> <type>[, ...]' line (present only on real failures, summed correctly for multi-type). The parenthetical breakdown extraction and the no-parenthetical-means-single-type attribution (tests_i=total_i, properties_i=0) match section 4.5's documented OQ-2b assumption verbatim, including its caveat. The four-way exit_i/failures_i cross-check (0/0 clean, 2/>0 consistent-failure, 2/0 anomaly-WARNING-only, anything-else WARNING+failed) is implemented exactly as section 4.5/2.2 specifies, and Step 5's exit code (`exit "$any_failed"`) is now purely a function of parsed failures_i and has-Result-line, not raw exit_i, matching section 4.6's corrected contract. This is a genuine correction, not a gate-loosening hack: the fix makes the script correctly read what mix test actually printed (a parsing-target fix), it does not widen what counts as a pass -- the one case that stays non-failing on a favorable read (exit 2, 0 parsed failures) still prints an explicit, non-swallowed WARNING and is traceable to design section 2.2/OQ-5's own source-level investigation of Mix's exit code path, not an arbitrary carve-out invented to make the script pass. Checked docs/anti-patterns.md's 'never satisfy a gate by editing what it measures' framing (cited at lines 302/387) -- this fix is the opposite pattern: it corrected the measurement instrument (the regex/parsing rule) to match verified reality, it did not touch requirements.yaml, the design's acceptance criteria, or add any --skip/--ignore-failures style bypass. Scope: `git show --stat dc93092` and `cf28a46` show only scripts/test_parallel.sh plus this run's own handoff JSON touched -- no workflow-doc, CI config, or REQ-114 wiring/aggregation-across-hosts work present. No Elixir/OTP code touched (N/A for supervision question). No new type-safety-representable invalid state introduced (still a bash script parsing text; the existing struct/type surface of the Elixir app is unaffected) so no docs/issues/ filing needed.
